target: AArch64 QEMU virt with ramfb and VirtIO keyboard/tablet
command: QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' python3 scripts/check-compat.py --probe-demo-varoom
checks: Launched the unchanged pinned /Demo/Games/Varoom.ZC from the graphical terminal in a focused application task.
The game scene rendered with visible graphics.
Right-arrow steering and Up speed input changed the rendered scene.
Escape restored the graphical terminal; 40+2 evaluated to 42 and zstatus reported failed=0.
scope_note: QEMU gameplay-input/render/exit acceptance; live UTM or Pi hardware behavior is not implied.
